question: Who among the following chess grandmasters won the ninth edition of the Sinquefield Cup in September 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alireza Firouzja**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The ninth edition of the Sinquefield Cup was held in September 2022.**
 
• The event concluded with a play-off after nine eventful rounds.
 
• The play-off consisted of two rapid games.
 
• **The play-off was between Grandmasters Ian Nepomniachtchi and Alireza Firouzja.**
 
• The winner of the **Sinquefield Cup in 2022 was Alireza Firouzja​.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Sinquefield Cup is an annual, invitation-only chess tournament held in St. Louis, Missouri.**
 
• Named after Rex Sinquefield, an **American businessman and chess patron, the Cup is part of the Grand Chess Tour, a series of international chess tournaments.**
 
• It has been hosting some of the** world's top players since its inception** in **2013**.
 
• **The format of the tournament is a 10-player round-robin, meaning each participant plays against every other participant.**
